theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: These models currently reuse the same numerical engineering policy; that equality does not establish identical hardware, separate equipment tuning or calibrated per-model fidelity.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Only selected finite V2 AAM source and turning-CPA/station fuze. Explicit finite geometry differs from retained V0 cousins; no C7 hardware internal reconstruction is inferred.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. SARH additionally requires actual separate illumination and pulse/PRF coincidence.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: No other current model in this family has this complete numeric policy and mechanism/receiver binding.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. SARH additionally requires actual separate illumination and pulse/PRF coincidence.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

sensitivity.limit: Integer period transitions, detector correlation and finite scan motion can change observability; these inferred design rules are not OEM data.
Fully correlated read charge instead scales with pixel_count; correlation is uncalibrated.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Finite imaging pixels/PSF, charge noise/ADC, background contrast and segmentation followed by measured feature association.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: aim-9x: thermal_image.v1; acquire_m=13000, gimbal_deg=45, sample_period_s=0.02, processing_delay_s=0.01, field_half_angle_rad=0.12, angle_noise_rad=0.0004, track_memory_s=0.12, ir_band_low_um=3, ir_band_high_um=5, receiver_pixel_pitch_rad=0.0015, receiver_psf_sigma_rad=0.00075, receiver_integration_s=1e-05, receiver_aperture_area_m2=0.0007917304360898403, receiver_quantum_efficiency=0.6. parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: These models currently reuse the same numerical engineering policy; that equality does not establish identical hardware, separate equipment tuning or calibrated per-model fidelity.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Finite imaging pixels/PSF, charge noise/ADC, background contrast and segmentation followed by measured feature association.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Imaging selection and its own card mass differ from AIM9M; shared WDU17/B reference is explicitly inherited, not independent measured X case geometry.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: No other current model in this family has this complete numeric policy and mechanism/receiver binding.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.

sensitivity.limit: Integer period transitions, detector correlation and finite scan motion can change observability; these inferred design rules are not OEM data.
Fully correlated read charge instead scales with pixel_count; correlation is uncalibrated.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Magic2 frontal detection and a historical multi-element description are not evidence for this scalar reticle. Pre-fragmented wording is represented by equivalent point fragments, not an authored preform map.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.

theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: mica-em: rf_signal.v1; acquire_m=17000, gimbal_deg=60, sample_period_s=0.02, processing_delay_s=0.01, field_half_angle_rad=0.12, angle_noise_rad=0.0004, track_memory_s=0.12, frequency_hz=10000000000.0, receiver_rf_aperture_width_m=0.096, receiver_rf_aperture_height_m=0.096, receiver_rf_dwell_s=0.012, receiver_rf_prfs=3, receiver_rf_gate_m=15, receiver_rf_pfa_interval=1e-06. Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: No other current model in this family has this complete numeric policy and mechanism/receiver binding.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: MBDA documents a dual-waveband imaging infrared seeker. Two independently radiometric, noisy detector channels execute measured angular pairing and spectral-continuity association; no truth identity or source class enters discrimination. Exact bands, detector constants and spectral gates are explicit uncertain engineering assumptions.
descriptor.validity: Dual-waveband physical execution; selected engineering passbands are not manufacturer-published hardware specifications or calibrated countermeasure performance.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Two finite image channels with their own charge/noise state and measured spectral pairing; unavailable passive range is never supplied.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: mica-ir: thermal_dual_image.v1; acquire_m=13000, gimbal_deg=45, sample_period_s=0.02, processing_delay_s=0.01, field_half_angle_rad=0.12, angle_noise_rad=0.0004, track_memory_s=0.12, ir_band_low_um=3, ir_band_high_um=5, receiver_pixel_pitch_rad=0.0015, receiver_psf_sigma_rad=0.00075, receiver_integration_s=1e-05, receiver_aperture_area_m2=0.0012566370614359172, receiver_quantum_efficiency=0.6. The actual receiver is dual-band imaging with separate channel and pairing policies, not the single-band or scalar-reticle receiver. Second actual band8–12um, effective photon wavelength10um, separate QE0.6/exposure10us/channel state; spectral pairing is a distinct gate.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: No other current model in this family has this complete numeric policy and mechanism/receiver binding.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Two finite image channels with their own charge/noise state and measured spectral pairing; unavailable passive range is never supplied.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: The actual receiver is dual-band imaging with separate channel and pairing policies, not the single-band or scalar-reticle receiver.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: These models currently reuse the same numerical engineering policy; that equality does not establish identical hardware, separate equipment tuning or calibrated per-model fidelity.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: No other current model in this family has this complete numeric policy and mechanism/receiver binding.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.

sensitivity.limit: Integer period transitions, detector correlation and finite scan motion can change observability; these inferred design rules are not OEM data.
Fully correlated read charge instead scales with pixel_count; correlation is uncalibrated.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.

sensitivity.limit: Integer period transitions, detector correlation and finite scan motion can change observability; these inferred design rules are not OEM data.
Fully correlated read charge instead scales with pixel_count; correlation is uncalibrated.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.

theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. SARH additionally requires actual separate illumination and pulse/PRF coincidence.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: No other current model in this family has this complete numeric policy and mechanism/receiver binding.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.

sensitivity.limit: Integer period transitions, detector correlation and finite scan motion can change observability; these inferred design rules are not OEM data.
Fully correlated read charge instead scales with pixel_count; correlation is uncalibrated.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: r-60m: thermal_conscan_reticle.v1; acquire_m=13000, gimbal_deg=45, sample_period_s=0.02, processing_delay_s=0.01, field_half_angle_rad=0.12, angle_noise_rad=0.0004, track_memory_s=0.12, ir_band_low_um=3, ir_band_high_um=5, receiver_pixel_pitch_rad=0.0015, receiver_psf_sigma_rad=0.00075, receiver_integration_s=1e-05, receiver_aperture_area_m2=0.0007068583470577034, receiver_quantum_efficiency=0.6, receiver_reticle_periods=12, receiver_reticle_frequency_hz=132.62911924324612, receiver_reticle_scan_radius_rad=0.024, receiver_reticle_stop_radius_rad=0.048. The card description mentions depleted-uranium rods, but the selected zoned-case source uses steel7850kg/m3 and discrete equivalent rods; no DU density, pyrophoricity or connected-ring capability is implemented by that name.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: No other current model in this family has this complete numeric policy and mechanism/receiver binding.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.

sensitivity.limit: Integer period transitions, detector correlation and finite scan motion can change observability; these inferred design rules are not OEM data.
Fully correlated read charge instead scales with pixel_count; correlation is uncalibrated.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: The card description mentions depleted-uranium rods, but the selected zoned-case source uses steel7850kg/m3 and discrete equivalent rods; no DU density, pyrophoricity or connected-ring capability is implemented by that name.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.

theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.

theory.equations: L=epsilon integral[2hc^2/(lambda^5(expm1(hc/lambda/k/T)))]dlambda; Q=L*Omega*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(hc); SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F).
theory.limits: Finite grey bands/rectangular projected patches, Gaussian PSF, effective photon wavelength, explicit detector/RF timing and assumed geometry. These method comparisons do not validate ECCM, Pd/Pfa or OEM acquisition envelope.
theory.delta: fsim.seeker.active_radar.v3: original selected physical receiver; IR quadrant charge versus imaging segmentation; SARH requires real separate illumination and temporal PRF coincidence; ARH uses own transmitter. All receive coefficients retain original card uncertainty.

primary_sources.title: NIST SP250-43, Radiance Temperature Calibrations (1998)
primary_sources.locator: Section 2, equation (4), printed page 6 (PDF page16)
primary_sources.scope: Vacuum spectral radiance law; integrated independently with the exact-SI constants, not the historical rounded constants.

primary_sources.title: BIPM SI Brochure, ninth edition, v4.01
primary_sources.locator: Section2.2, defining constants h,c,k, English tables2 and4
primary_sources.scope: Exact SI h=6.62607015e-34 J s, c=299792458 m/s, k=1.380649e-23 J/K; no fitted radiometric coefficient.

primary_sources.title: MIT Lincoln Laboratory, O'Donnell, Introduction to Radar Systems: The Radar Equation (2002)
primary_sources.locator: Slides5-10,13: power-density, effective area, kTB and track radar equation
primary_sources.scope: Free-space received power and thermal noise. Energy integration and bistatic Rt/Rr separation are explicitly derived here, not OEM receiver data.

method.case: Actual selected-provider native capture versus independent primary equations

shared_equivalence.scope: The exact shared production numerical mechanism with each model's full original resolved parameter records; separate native observations for every model.
shared_equivalence.limits: Only listed equations and cohort-specific controls; not equivalent OEM hardware, calibrated parameters, coupled scene outcomes, public or visual acceptance.
